title: Christmas movie fondue (brown Meltie mug, bar counter) — restage 03
notes: Restage 03 of shorts/Su66AMPolD0 ("you + me?"): BROWN variant of the real Meltie Mini Fondue Mug (store photos), the treats on the black granite breakfast bar (a black granite breakfast bar in a dark modern kitchen at night, leather bar stools at the side, matte black cabinets and a warm under-cabinet light strip behind) instead of the white desk in front of a red curtain and a Christmas tree. Table decor kept (gnome pumpkin, pumpkins, candle jar, laptop). Reworded hook. The pour and the last dip spill on purpose (brief). Laptop: generated fictional holiday-film stills (no children, no real film footage); plain unbranded red bag; Sora audio.

product.name: Meltie Mug Mini Fondue Mug, brown
product.description: the BROWN Meltie Mini Fondue Mug exactly as in the product photos: glossy chocolate-brown ceramic body that flares wider at the top, a white interior, 'Chocolate...' in white cursive script with a small white swirl mark on the front, a tall arched opening at the base for a tealight, an angular brown handle on the right with a small round hole, and a fondue fork with a terracotta-brown handle and long steel tines that clips into the handle

style: Cosy Christmas movie night at home in the evening, at a KITCHEN BAR COUNTER: everything happens on the black granite breakfast bar; a dim warm room lit only by warm under-cabinet light strips and the candle, deep soft shadows, no bright studio light, no red curtains, no Christmas tree. Handheld vertical phone video at table height, shallow depth of field, rich warm colour grade. Hands have long glossy deep-red manicured nails. The laptop screen is always flat chroma-key green. No on-screen text, no logos.

The spill is clearly visible as streams and a big puddle, while the mug's shape, its handle and the 'Chocolate...' lettering on its front stay clearly visible: the streams run down the sides, not over the front.
